scripts.build: npm run bundle:games && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.bundle:games: npx esbuild src/games/davinci/engine.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=server/bundled/coda.mjs --platform=neutral && npx esbuild src/games/flip7/engine.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=server/bundled/flip.mjs --platform=neutral && npx esbuild src/games/blackjack/engine.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=server/bundled/bj.mjs --platform=neutral && npx esbuild src/games/math24/engine.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=server/bundled/m24.mjs --platform=neutral && npx esbuild src/games/uno/engine.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=server/bundled/uno.mjs --platform=neutral
scripts.server: npm run bundle:games && npm start --prefix server
